evidence_class: Public open-source build plus independent application-tool controls; no proprietary execution

build.compiler:
Apple clang version 17.0.0 (clang-1700.4.4.1)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin27.0.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin
build.cmake:
cmake version 3.28.20231116-g2c923a7

CMake suite maintained and supported by Kitware (kitware.com/cmake).

bridge.create: Float32 interleaved io(0,0), quality(6,0)=VHQ28bit, runtime(0); finite integral8k..192k mono/stereo; nearest rounding required
bridge.process: Reports actual library consumed/produced counts; forwards NULL input EOF. No automatic retry, gain, artificial padding, native carry or wrapper count policy. On library error caller must discard handle.
bridge.dependency_direction: RebaseCore -> RebaseSoXR -> RebaseTimingDSP (callback header). TimingDSP does not depend on bridge.

controls.result: 8 mono/stereo direct-public API versus bridge comparisons at upsample/downsample/equal rates; every produced sample bit and every consumed/produced count matched. Domain/rounding/error-output controls passed. This compares two call paths to the SAME public backend.
controls.reproducibility_limit: Byte equality demonstrated across two build directories with the same recorded host/compiler/SDK/options, not arbitrary toolchains.

distribution.source: Complete upstream tree and build scripts bundled under Contents/Resources/ThirdParty
notices: upstream FFT source notices and optional-source licenses retained
distribution.source_modification: REBASE_SOXR_ALLOW_MODIFIED_SOURCE=1 permits rebuilding modified source and records actual hashes. No source modification in this accepted build.
distribution.application_packaging: build-app.sh removes development library rpath, retains bundle Frameworks rpath, signs nested library, bundles corresponding source/notices. Actual final Rebase bundle verification belongs to APP012 release acceptance.

retained_issues: Initial conservative tar extraction stopped at an internal relative symlink. Extraction resumed only after verifying every existing byte and target confinement; exact symlink preserved.
Upstream CMake emits compatibility/source-extension policy warnings on the installed newer CMake; unchanged source compiles successfully.
limits: Public source identity and version string do not establish the bundled proprietary source modifications, compiler/SIMD/FP configuration, or output equivalence.
Scalar CR32+CR64/noSIMD/noOpenMP/noVR is an explicit independent build choice; vendor build flags remain unknown.
Native mode2 padding/carry/EOF is implemented separately by the injected wrapper; this bridge does not substitute plain soxr_process for that contract.
No Cubase runtime or DAC comparison. Complete live-engine callback topology and general project playback remain outside this study.
